dialogueInline.speaker: Abby
dialogueInline.text: The route is public. The assignments aren't. Gravefire owns the mouth; nobody crosses her wake.

dialogueInline.speaker: Billie
dialogueInline.text: You don't give orders to Ashfang.

dialogueInline.speaker: Abby
dialogueInline.text: Then I want every dock crew to know whose ship puts civilians in the firing line.

dialogueInline.speaker: Pike
dialogueInline.text: The cameras will know where Broken Oath stood.

dialogueInline.speaker: Abby
dialogueInline.text: Let them see you hold the position you're given.

dialogueInline.speaker: Halev
dialogueInline.text: That hall was meant for grain. It's our last clear freight floor.

dialogueInline.speaker: Naomi
dialogueInline.text: I'm boarding families onto cold skiffs because you promised them heat.

dialogueInline.speaker: Halev
dialogueInline.text: If they sleep there, the next grain ship has nowhere to unload.

dialogueInline.speaker: Naomi
dialogueInline.text: And if they stay on the dock tonight?

dialogueInline.speaker: Halev
dialogueInline.text: Open the hall. I'll answer the freighter when it comes.

panelPlan: Halev walks through a freight hall where a loading crew is moving the last available heater banks.
Naomi, preparing to launch, speaks to Halev over an open comm while families board cold civilian skiffs.
Halev stands between the freight pallets and provisional bedding spaces, answering Naomi on comm as the loading crew waits for his decision.
He has the heaters rolled toward the receiving area while the freight crew has to stop unloading.

dialogueInline.speaker: Officer
dialogueInline.text: That tug's lost thrust. The picket has a clean shot at anything that reaches it.

dialogueInline.speaker: Pike
dialogueInline.text: Broken Oath can make the turn. Take us out.

dialogueInline.speaker: Officer
dialogueInline.text: The tow's too heavy with our relief pallet. The dockhands spent days loading it.

dialogueInline.speaker: Pike
dialogueInline.text: I know. Cut it. The tug's crew can't wait.

panelPlan: Broken Oath, already turned stern-on after Abby's warning, still has camera drones hunting for a heroic angle. A powerless civilian tug drifts beyond the picket edge.
Pike spots the tug, abandons the remaining broadcast framing, and orders a high-risk intercept.
Broken Oath crosses the hostile line under fire; tow hooks or a line latch onto the disabled tug with believable ship scales.
The crew cuts free a substantial pallet of relief freight to reduce the overloaded tow; it spins into inaccessible space.
Pike hauls the rescued civilians back as the cameras lose the unscripted maneuver entirely.

dialogueInline.speaker: Naomi
dialogueInline.text: Is the freight hall warm enough?

dialogueInline.speaker: Mother
dialogueInline.text: It is tonight. They say the food comes later.

dialogueInline.speaker: Mother
dialogueInline.text: My daughter keeps asking whether she should unpack. I can't tell her to carry those bags forever.

dialogueInline.speaker: Naomi
dialogueInline.text: Give me the heavy one. She doesn't have to carry it tonight.

panelPlan: In the receiving hall the mother checks her small bedding allotment while a volunteer tests a heater pack. Naomi approaches the family.
Naomi, still in Verge flight gear, crouches at the adult's level beside the family's bags.
The girl quietly adds Broken Oath to a ship drawing on a blank scrap, while her mother admits she cannot promise they can unpack for good.
Naomi takes the heavy bag and walks with them toward the heated hall, where empty freight space is now occupied by people.
